title: Implement Prometheus metrics registry and /metrics endpoint
description:
Set up a shared Prometheus metrics registry (prometheus crate or metrics crate). Expose /metrics on a configurable admin HTTP port. Define metric taxonomy: counters (articles_ingested_total, articles_served_total, gc_articles_unpinned_total, gossip_messages_published_total, gossip_messages_dropped_total), gauges (peer_connections_active, groups_served, pinned_articles_total), histograms (ipfs_write_latency_seconds, nntp_command_duration_seconds labeled by command). Artifact: core/src/metrics.rs + admin HTTP handler.

Acceptance:
- /metrics returns valid Prometheus text format (parseable by promtool)
- All counters, gauges, and histograms listed above are present
- Metric names follow snake_case convention; counters end in _total
- Histogram buckets for latency: [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0]
- Unit test: verify metric names and types with promtool or by parsing output
